concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
question: Which of the following princely states was taken over by the East India Company in the year 1852 AD under the principle of Whatchaap (Hadap Policy)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udaipur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Udaipur **was taken over by the East India Company in the year 1852 AD under the principle of Whatchaap (Hadap Policy).
 
• The Whatchaap or Hadap Policy was a doctrine applied by the British to annex Indian princely states that were either misgoverned or had no legitimate heir to the throne.
 
• This policy was part of the British strategy to expand their control in India.
 
• Sambalpur was one of the key regions affected by this policy during the mid-19th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Doctrine of Lapse** was another policy implemented by the British, where if a ruler died without a male heir, the state would be annexed.
 
• Lord Dalhousie, the Governor-General of India from 1848 to 1856, was a key proponent of these annexation policies.
 
• Other states annexed under similar policies included Satara, Jhansi, and Nagpur.
 
• These policies contributed significantly to the expansion of British territories in India, leading to increased dissatisfaction and eventually the Revolt of 1857.
